content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (rule T4C — Termination for convenience)

- **Customer right:** § 14 (p0079) lets Client terminate at will on written notice, with services running only to the last day of the month following the notice month — an effective 30–60 days. No early-termination fee or penalty appears anywhere in the agreement (the "Section 4" cross-reference points to the minimum monthly fee schedule).
- **Vendor right:** TrueLink has no mid-term convenience right; § 13 (p0078) gives it only non-renewal of the one-year term, and its other exit triggers are cause-based (Client breach of §§ 8a–8c or repository/system agreements).
- **Term length:** 12 months with annual auto-renewal, so the multi-year walk-away scenario does not arise.

Noted but not flagged (minor sub-elements): no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees — moot because § 5 (p0045) bills monthly in arrears, so nothing is prepaid; and TrueLink's non-renewal notice is 30 days rather than the preferred 90, a reciprocal right we hold on identical terms. No redline proposed.
